title: BLT Burning Love Twin
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Identical high school twins swap places for a day: Nozomu, from a school for delinquents, goes to confront an enemy and find out why a teacher keeps calling his brother, while Saku, a prestigious school's class president, tries to pass as Nozomu. Nozomu's close friend Yoji starts making more than friendly moves on Saku, who plays along to protect his cover. The volume adds three other short stories (AniList, MU from Digital Manga).
life_message: Stepping into someone else's life can reveal who really cares about you.
